(module asl-syntax/js/lex
                                                                                                                                                                                      
  :x [LexGoal
      goalDefault
      goalRegex
      goalTemplate
      goalJsxText
      lexJs
      lexJsGoal
      lexJsText
      lexJsSource
      tokensToNode
      tokenSliceString
      tokenSliceBytes
      hasPrecedingNewline
      isWhitespaceToken
      isNewlineToken
      isCommentToken
      isHashbangToken
      isIdentToken
      isKeywordToken
      isNumberToken
      isStringToken
      isTemplateToken
      isRegexToken
      isPunctToken
      isJsxTextToken
      isPrivateNameToken
      isInvalidToken]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)
      (asl-syntax/core/tree :a tr)])

(enum LexGoal
  (:c goalDefault [] "Divide-or-regex decided by previous significant token")
  (:c goalRegex [] "A / at this position starts a regular expression")
  (:c goalTemplate [] "Lexing resumes inside a template continuation")
  (:c goalJsxText [] "Lexing resumes in JSX text mode"))

(schema TplChunk
  (:f tok tr/Token)
  (:f next Int64)
  (:f opensSubst Bool))

fn goalIsDefault goal: LexGoal -> Bool
  (mt goal ((goalDefault) true) (_ false))

fn goalIsRegex goal: LexGoal -> Bool
  (mt goal ((goalRegex) true) (_ false))

fn goalIsJsxText goal: LexGoal -> Bool
  (mt goal ((goalJsxText) true) (_ false))

fn isWhitespaceToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "whitespace")

fn isNewlineToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "newline")

fn isCommentToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "comment")

fn isHashbangToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "hashbang")

fn isIdentToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "ident")

fn isKeywordToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "keyword")

fn isNumberToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "number")

fn isStringToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "string")

fn isTemplateToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "template")

fn isRegexToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "regex")

fn isPunctToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "punct")

fn isJsxTextToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "jsxText")

fn isPrivateNameToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "privateName")

fn isInvalidToken tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (= tok.kind     "invalid")

fn isWsByte b: Int64 -> Bool
  (or (= b 32)
  (or (= b 9)
  (or (= b 11)
      (= b 12))))

fn isDigitByte b: Int64 -> Bool
  (and (>= b 48) (<= b 57))

fn isHexDigitByte b: Int64 -> Bool
  (or (and (>= b 48) (<= b 57))
  (or (and (>= b 65) (<= b 70))
      (and (>= b 97) (<= b 102))))

fn isIdentStartByte b: Int64 -> Bool
  (or (and (>= b 65) (<= b 90))
  (or (and (>= b 97) (<= b 122))
  (or (= b 95)
  (or (= b 36)
      (>= b 128)))))

fn isIdentContByte b: Int64 -> Bool
  (or (isIdentStartByte b)
      (isDigitByte b))

fn isUnicodeLineSep bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Bool
  (and (< (+ i 2) len)
       (and (= (bytesGet bs i) 226)
            (and (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 128)
                 (or (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 2)) 168)
                     (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 2)) 169)))))

fn scanWhitespaceRun bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i len)
    i
    (if (isWsByte (bytesGet bs i))
      (scanWhitespaceRun bs len (+ i 1))
      i))

fn scanNewlineLen bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
    (if (= b 13)
      (if (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 10)) 2 1)
      1))

fn scanLineComment bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i len)
    len
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
      (if (or (= b 10) (= b 13))
        i
        (if (isUnicodeLineSep bs len i)
          i
          (scanLineComment bs len (+ i 1))))))

fn scanBlockComment bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i len)
    len
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
      (if (and (= b 42) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 47)))
        (+ i 2)
        (scanBlockComment bs len (+ i 1)))))

fn scanString bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 quote: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    len
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (cond
        ((= b 92)
         (if (< (+ j 1) len)
           (let [(nb (bytesGet bs (+ j 1)))]
             (if (and (= nb 13) (and (< (+ j 2) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 2)) 10)))
               (scanString bs len (+ j 3) quote)
               (scanString bs len (+ j 2) quote)))
           len))
        ((= b quote) (+ j 1))
        ((or (= b 10) (= b 13)) j)
        (else (scanString bs len (+ j 1) quote)))))

fn scanRegexFlags bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (or (and (>= b 97) (<= b 122)) (or (and (>= b 65) (<= b 90)) (>= b 128)))
        (scanRegexFlags bs len (+ j 1))
        j))))

fn scanRegex bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 inClass: Bool -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    len
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (cond
        ((= b 92)
         (if (< (+ j 1) len)
           (scanRegex bs len (+ j 2) inClass)
           len))
        ((= b 91) (scanRegex bs len (+ j 1) true))
        ((and (= b 93) inClass) (scanRegex bs len (+ j 1) false))
        ((= b 47)
         (if inClass
           (scanRegex bs len (+ j 1) true)
           (scanRegexFlags bs len (+ j 1))))
        ((or (= b 10) (= b 13)) j)
        ((isUnicodeLineSep bs len j) j)
        (else (scanRegex bs len (+ j 1) inClass)))))

fn scanDigitsRun bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (or (isDigitByte b) (= b 95))
        (scanDigitsRun bs len (+ j 1))
        j))))

fn scanHexRun bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (or (isHexDigitByte b) (= b 95))
        (scanHexRun bs len (+ j 1))
        j))))

fn scanOctalRun bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (or (and (>= b 48) (<= b 55)) (= b 95))
        (scanOctalRun bs len (+ j 1))
        j))))

fn scanBinaryRun bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (or (= b 48) (or (= b 49) (= b 95)))
        (scanBinaryRun bs len (+ j 1))
        j))))

fn scanRadixEnd bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(e (scanHexRun bs len j))]
    (if (and (< e len) (= (bytesGet bs e) 110))
      (+ e 1)
      e)))

fn scanOctalEnd bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(e (scanOctalRun bs len j))]
    (if (and (< e len) (= (bytesGet bs e) 110))
      (+ e 1)
      e)))

fn scanBinaryEnd bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(e (scanBinaryRun bs len j))]
    (if (and (< e len) (= (bytesGet bs e) 110))
      (+ e 1)
      e)))

fn scanDecimal bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(j0 (scanDigitsRun bs len i))
        (afterDot (if (and (< j0 len)
                           (and (= (bytesGet bs j0) 46)
                                (and (< (+ j0 1) len)
                                     (isDigitByte (bytesGet bs (+ j0 1))))))
                    (scanDigitsRun bs len (+ j0 1))
                    j0))
        (afterExp (if (and (< afterDot len)
                           (or (= (bytesGet bs afterDot) 101)
                               (= (bytesGet bs afterDot) 69)))
                    (let [(k0 (+ afterDot 1))
                          (k1 (if (and (< k0 len)
                                       (or (= (bytesGet bs k0) 43)
                                           (= (bytesGet bs k0) 45)))
                                (+ k0 1)
                                k0))]
                      (if (and (< k1 len) (isDigitByte (bytesGet bs k1)))
                        (scanDigitsRun bs len k1)
                        afterDot))
                    afterDot))]
    (if (and (< afterExp len)
             (and (= (bytesGet bs afterExp) 110)
                  (or (>= (+ afterExp 1) len)
                      (not (isIdentContByte (bytesGet bs (+ afterExp 1)))))))
      (+ afterExp 1)
      afterExp)))

fn scanNumber bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(b0 (bytesGet bs i))]
    (if (and (= b0 48) (< (+ i 1) len))
      (let [(n1 (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)))]
        (cond
          ((or (= n1 120) (= n1 88)) (scanRadixEnd bs len (+ i 2)))
          ((or (= n1 111) (= n1 79)) (scanOctalEnd bs len (+ i 2)))
          ((or (= n1 98) (= n1 66)) (scanBinaryEnd bs len (+ i 2)))
          (else (scanDecimal bs len i))))
      (scanDecimal bs len i))))

fn scanHexBraceEnd bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (if (isHexDigitByte b)
        (scanHexBraceEnd bs len (+ j 1))
        (if (= b 125) (+ j 1) j)))))

fn scanHex4End bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 count: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (or (>= j len) (>= count 4))
    j
    (if (isHexDigitByte (bytesGet bs j))
      (scanHex4End bs len (+ j 1) (+ count 1))
      j)))

fn scanUnicodeEscapeEnd bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (and (< (+ j 2) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 2)) 123))
    (scanHexBraceEnd bs len (+ j 3))
    (scanHex4End bs len (+ j 2) 0)))

fn scanIdent bs: Bytes len: Int64 j: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= j len)
    j
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (cond
        ((isIdentContByte b) (scanIdent bs len (+ j 1)))
        ((and (= b 92)
              (and (< (+ j 1) len)
                   (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 1)) 117)))
         (scanIdent bs len (scanUnicodeEscapeEnd bs len j)))
        ((and (= b 226)
              (and (< (+ j 2) len)
                   (and (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 1)) 128)
                        (or (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 2)) 139)
                            (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 2)) 140)))))
         (scanIdent bs len (+ j 3)))
        (else j)))))

fn scanJsxText bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i len)
    i
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
      (if (and (not (= b 60)) (not (= b 123)))
        (scanJsxText bs len (+ i 1))
        i))))

fn scanTpl bs: Bytes len: Int64 start: Int64 j: Int64 -> TplChunk
  (if (>= j len)
    (TplChunk :tok (tr/makeToken "template" start len) :next len :opensSubst false)
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs j))]
      (cond
        ((= b 92)
         (if (< (+ j 1) len)
           (scanTpl bs len start (+ j 2))
           (TplChunk :tok (tr/makeToken "template" start len) :next len :opensSubst false)))
        ((= b 96)
         (TplChunk :tok (tr/makeToken "template" start (+ j 1)) :next (+ j 1) :opensSubst false))
        ((and (= b 36)
              (and (< (+ j 1) len)
                   (= (bytesGet bs (+ j 1)) 123)))
         (TplChunk :tok (tr/makeToken "template" start (+ j 2)) :next (+ j 2) :opensSubst true))
        (else (scanTpl bs len start (+ j 1)))))))

fn scanTemplateChunk bs: Bytes len: Int64 start: Int64 fromIdx: Int64 -> TplChunk
  (scanTpl bs len start fromIdx))

fn bytesRangeEqLoop bs: Bytes start: Int64 expected: Bytes j: Int64 n: Int64 -> Bool
  (if (>= j n)
    true
    (if (= (bytesGet bs (+ start j)) (bytesGet expected j))
      (bytesRangeEqLoop bs start expected (+ j 1) n)
      false)))

fn bytesRangeEq bs: Bytes start: Int64 expected: Bytes -> Bool
  (let [(n (bytesLength expected))]
    (bytesRangeEqLoop bs start expected 0 n)))

fn classifyIdent bs: Bytes start: Int64 end: Int64 -> String
  (let [(b0 (bytesGet bs start))
        (l (- end start))]
    (cond
      ((= b0 97)
       (if (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "await"))) "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 98)
       (if (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "break"))) "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 99)
       (if (or (and (= l 4) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "case")))
             (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "catch")))
             (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "class")))
             (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "const")))
                 (and (= l 8) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "continue")))))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 100)
       (if (or (and (= l 8) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "debugger")))
             (or (and (= l 7) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "default")))
             (or (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "delete")))
                 (and (= l 2) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "do"))))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 101)
       (if (or (and (= l 4) (or (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "else"))
                                (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "enum"))))
             (or (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "export")))
                 (and (= l 7) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "extends")))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 102)
       (if (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "false")))
             (or (and (= l 7) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "finally")))
             (or (and (= l 3) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "for")))
                 (and (= l 8) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "function"))))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 105)
       (if (or (and (= l 2) (or (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "if"))
                                (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "in"))))
             (or (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "import")))
                 (and (= l 10) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "instanceof")))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 108)
       (if (and (= l 3) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "let"))) "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 110)
       (if (or (and (= l 3) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "new")))
               (and (= l 4) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "null"))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 114)
       (if (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "return"))) "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 115)
       (if (or (and (= l 5) (or (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "super"))
                                (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "static"))))
               (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "switch"))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 116)
       (if (or (and (= l 4) (or (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "this"))
                                (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "true"))))
             (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "throw")))
             (or (and (= l 3) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "try")))
                 (and (= l 6) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "typeof"))))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 118)
       (if (or (and (= l 3) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "var")))
               (and (= l 4) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "void"))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 119)
       (if (or (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "while")))
               (and (= l 4) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "with"))))
         "keyword" "ident"))
      ((= b0 121)
       (if (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "yield"))) "keyword" "ident"))
      (else "ident"))))

fn literalLikeKeyword bs: Bytes start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Bool
  (let [(b0 (bytesGet bs start))
        (l (- end start))]
    (cond
      ((= b0 116)
       (and (= l 4)
            (or (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "this"))
                (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "true")))))
      ((= b0 110)
       (and (= l 4) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "null"))))
      ((= b0 102)
       (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "false"))))
      ((= b0 115)
       (and (= l 5) (bytesRangeEq bs start (stringToBytes "super"))))
      (else false))))

fn punctAllowsRegex pLen: Int64 bs: Bytes i: Int64 -> Bool
  (if (= pLen 1)
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
      (not (or (= b 41)
           (or (= b 93)
           (or (= b 125)
               (= b 46))))))
    (if (= pLen 2)
      (let [(b0 (bytesGet bs i))
            (b1 (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)))]
        (not (or (and (= b0 43) (= b1 43))
             (or (and (= b0 45) (= b1 45))
                 (and (= b0 63) (= b1 46))))))
      true)))

fn punctLen bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(b0 (bytesGet bs i))
        (b1 (if (< (+ i 1) len) (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 0))
        (b2 (if (< (+ i 2) len) (bytesGet bs (+ i 2)) 0))
        (b3 (if (< (+ i 3) len) (bytesGet bs (+ i 3)) 0))]
    (cond
      ((and (= b0 62) (and (= b1 62) (and (= b2 62) (= b3 61)))) 4)
      ((and (= b0 61) (and (= b1 61) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 33) (and (= b1 61) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 62) (and (= b1 62) (= b2 62))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 60) (and (= b1 60) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 62) (and (= b1 62) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 42) (and (= b1 42) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 38) (and (= b1 38) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 124) (and (= b1 124) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 63) (and (= b1 63) (= b2 61))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 46) (and (= b1 46) (= b2 46))) 3)
      ((and (= b0 61) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 33) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 60) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 62) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 61) (= b1 62)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 43) (= b1 43)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 45) (= b1 45)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 60) (= b1 60)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 62) (= b1 62)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 42) (= b1 42)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 38) (= b1 38)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 124) (= b1 124)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 63) (= b1 63)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 63) (and (= b1 46) (not (isDigitByte b2)))) 2)
      ((and (= b0 43) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 45) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 42) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 47) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 37) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 38) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 124) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((and (= b0 94) (= b1 61)) 2)
      ((or (= b0 123) (or (= b0 125) (or (= b0 40) (or (= b0 41)
       (or (= b0 91) (or (= b0 93) (or (= b0 46) (or (= b0 59)
       (or (= b0 44) (or (= b0 58) (or (= b0 63) (or (= b0 126)
       (or (= b0 43) (or (= b0 45) (or (= b0 42) (or (= b0 37)
       (or (= b0 38) (or (= b0 124) (or (= b0 94) (or (= b0 33)
       (or (= b0 60) (or (= b0 62) (or (= b0 61) (or (= b0 47)
       (= b0 64)))))))))))))))))))))))))
       1)
      (else 0))))

fn lexLoop bs: Bytes len: Int64 i: Int64 acc: (List tr/Token) goal: LexGoal tplDepths: (List Int64) prevRegexOk: Bool -> (List tr/Token)
  (if (>= i len)
    (listReverse acc)
    (let [(b (bytesGet bs i))]
      (cond
        ((and (goalIsJsxText goal) (and (not (= b 60)) (not (= b 123))))
         (let [(e (scanJsxText bs len i))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "jsxText" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((and (= i 0) (and (= b 35) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 33))))
         (let [(e (scanLineComment bs len (+ i 2)))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "hashbang" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((isWsByte b)
         (let [(e (scanWhitespaceRun bs len i))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "whitespace" i e) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk)))
        ((and (= b 239) (and (< (+ i 2) len) (and (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 187) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 2)) 191))))
         (lexLoop bs len (+ i 3) (cons (tr/makeToken "whitespace" i (+ i 3)) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk))
        ((and (= b 194) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 160)))
         (lexLoop bs len (+ i 2) (cons (tr/makeToken "whitespace" i (+ i 2)) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk))
        ((or (= b 10) (= b 13))
         (let [(n (scanNewlineLen bs len i))]
           (lexLoop bs len (+ i n) (cons (tr/makeToken "newline" i (+ i n)) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk)))
        ((isUnicodeLineSep bs len i)
         (lexLoop bs len (+ i 3) (cons (tr/makeToken "newline" i (+ i 3)) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk))
        ((and (= b 47) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 47)))
         (let [(e (scanLineComment bs len (+ i 2)))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "comment" i e) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk)))
        ((and (= b 47) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 42)))
         (let [(e (scanBlockComment bs len (+ i 2)))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "comment" i e) acc) goal tplDepths prevRegexOk)))
        ((or (= b 34) (= b 39))
         (let [(e (scanString bs len (+ i 1) b))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "string" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((= b 96)
         (let [(chunk (scanTemplateChunk bs len i (+ i 1)))]
           (if chunk.opensSubst    
             (lexLoop bs len chunk.next     (cons chunk.tok     acc) goal (cons 0 tplDepths) true)
             (lexLoop bs len chunk.next     (cons chunk.tok     acc) goal tplDepths false))))
        ((and (not (listEmpty? tplDepths)) (= b 125))
         (let [(topDepth (optionOr (listHead tplDepths) 0))]
           (if (= topDepth 0)
             (let [(restDepths (optionOr (listTail tplDepths) (list)))
                   (chunk (scanTemplateChunk bs len (+ i 1) (+ i 1)))]
               (if chunk.opensSubst    
                 (lexLoop bs len chunk.next    
                   (cons chunk.tok     (cons (tr/makeToken "punct" i (+ i 1)) acc))
                   goal (cons 0 restDepths) true)
                 (lexLoop bs len chunk.next    
                   (cons chunk.tok     (cons (tr/makeToken "punct" i (+ i 1)) acc))
                   goal restDepths false)))
             (let [(restDepths (optionOr (listTail tplDepths) (list)))]
               (lexLoop bs len (+ i 1)
                 (cons (tr/makeToken "punct" i (+ i 1)) acc)
                 goal (cons (- topDepth 1) restDepths) false)))))
        ((and (not (listEmpty? tplDepths)) (= b 123))
         (let [(topDepth (optionOr (listHead tplDepths) 0))
               (restDepths (optionOr (listTail tplDepths) (list)))]
           (lexLoop bs len (+ i 1)
             (cons (tr/makeToken "punct" i (+ i 1)) acc)
             goal (cons (+ topDepth 1) restDepths) true)))
        ((and (= b 47)
              (or (goalIsRegex goal)
                  (and (goalIsDefault goal) prevRegexOk)))
         (let [(e (scanRegex bs len (+ i 1) false))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "regex" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((isDigitByte b)
         (let [(e (scanNumber bs len i))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "number" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((and (= b 46) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (isDigitByte (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)))))
         (let [(e (scanNumber bs len i))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "number" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((and (= b 35) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (isIdentStartByte (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)))))
         (let [(e (scanIdent bs len (+ i 1)))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken "privateName" i e) acc) goal tplDepths false)))
        ((or (isIdentStartByte b)
             (and (= b 92) (and (< (+ i 1) len) (= (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)) 117))))
         (let [(e (scanIdent bs len i))
               (kind (classifyIdent bs i e))]
           (lexLoop bs len e (cons (tr/makeToken kind i e) acc) goal tplDepths
             (if (= kind "keyword")
               (not (literalLikeKeyword bs i e))
               false))))
        (else
         (let [(n (punctLen bs len i))]
           (if (> n 0)
             (lexLoop bs len (+ i n) (cons (tr/makeToken "punct" i (+ i n)) acc) goal tplDepths (punctAllowsRegex n bs i))
             (lexLoop bs len (+ i 1) (cons (tr/makeToken "invalid" i (+ i 1)) acc) goal tplDepths true))))))))

fn lexJsGoal bs: Bytes goal: LexGoal -> (List tr/Token)
  (let [(len (bytesLength bs))]
    (mt goal
      ((goalTemplate)
       (let [(chunk (scanTemplateChunk bs len 0 0))]
         (if chunk.opensSubst    
           (lexLoop bs len chunk.next     (list chunk.tok    ) (goalDefault) (cons 0 (list)) true)
           (lexLoop bs len chunk.next     (list chunk.tok    ) (goalDefault) (list) false))))
      (_
       (lexLoop bs len 0 (list) goal (list) true)))))

fn lexJs bs: Bytes -> (List tr/Token)
  (lexJsGoal bs (goalDefault))

fn lexJsText text: String -> (List tr/Token)
  (lexJs (stringToBytes text))

fn lexJsSource s: src/Source -> (List tr/Token)
  (lexJs (src/sourceBytes s))

fn tokensToElems tokens: (List tr/Token) acc: (List tr/TreeElement) -> (List tr/TreeElement)
  (if (listEmpty? tokens)
    (listReverse acc)
    (let [(tok (optionOr (listHead tokens) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)))
          (rest (optionOr (listTail tokens) (list)))]
      (tokensToElems rest (cons (tr/elemToken tok) acc)))))

fn tokensToNode tokens: (List tr/Token) len: Int64 -> tr/Node
  (tr/makeNode "js" 0 len (tokensToElems tokens (list))))

fn copySlice bs: Bytes srcIdx: Int64 dst: Bytes dstIdx: Int64 count: Int64 -> Unit
  (if (<= count 0)
    ()
    (do
      (bytesSet dst dstIdx (bytesGet bs srcIdx))
      (copySlice bs (+ srcIdx 1) dst (+ dstIdx 1) (- count 1))))

fn tokenSliceString text: String tok: tr/Token -> String
  (optionOr (stringSlice text tok.start     tok.end    ) "")

fn tokenSliceBytes bs: Bytes tok: tr/Token -> Bytes
  (let [(len (tr/tokenLength tok))
        (out (bytesAlloc len))]
    (do
      (copySlice bs tok.start     out 0 len)
      out)))

fn hasPrecedingNewline tokens: (List tr/Token) idx: Int64 -> Bool
  (if (<= idx 0)
    false
    (mt (listGet tokens (- idx 1))
      ((some t)
       (cond
         ((= t.kind     "newline") true)
         ((or (= t.kind     "whitespace") (= t.kind     "comment"))
          (hasPrecedingNewline tokens (- idx 1)))
         (else false)))
      ((none) false)))
